recipe.name: Chicken fajita bowls
recipe.instructions: Slice and saute the chicken and peppers in oil with fajita spices. Serve over rice and beans.
recipe.notes: Dairy-free as written. Do not add sour cream or cheese.

recipe.name: Baked mac and cheese
recipe.instructions: Boil the pasta, make the cheese sauce with milk and butter, bake until bubbling.
recipe.notes: Contains milk and cheese (from the owner's dairy days; kept for guests).

recipe.name: Salmon, sweet potato and broccoli
recipe.instructions: Roast everything on one tray at 425 F for 25 minutes.

recipe.name: Turkey chili with sour cream
recipe.instructions: Simmer the chili. Top with a spoon of Greek yogurt.

recipe.name: Grandma's vegetable soup
recipe.instructions: Everything in the big pot, simmer until soft. Season to taste.
recipe.ingredientsText:
2 carrots
1 onion
3 stalks celery
1 can diced tomatoes
4 cups stock
salt and pepper
recipe.notes: Written down from memory; no nutrition listed on purpose.
